decision: PASS. Both candidate-2 compositions visibly establish Nika handing a document folder to Matteo while Leo observes from the doorway. Nika's extended arm and Matteo's open receiving hand establish the intended recipient in both formats, resolving the candidate-1 staging concern. Nika retains her short, dark, wavy hairstyle and recognizable facial features; Matteo retains his darker hair, strong facial structure, and visible stubble; Leo remains distinguishable through his lighter hair, youthful features, clean-shaven face, and olive shirt beneath a pale jacket. The professional archive setting, restrained expressions, and physical separation communicate a serious confrontation without coercion or romantic framing. Giulia is absent, consistent with the three-character scene. Neither composition shows readable invented document text, additional cast members, baked interface elements, or visible watermarks. Both formats satisfy the visual acceptance criteria.
